scoring_justification: Full dynamic Monte Carlo simulation cannot be re-executed by the checker; we compare per-condition mean scaled yields to hidden reference values from the paper using a relative tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold mean scaled yields per (ε_d, ε_n) condition
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Approximated from Figure 3 of the paper (Whitelam, Phys. Rev. Lett. 105, 088102, 2010). Values reflect the general trend: moderate nonspecific attraction enhances yield for ε_d ≤ 9; no enhancement for ε_d = 10.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Read off approximate data points from the figure; smoothed to consistent trends.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the paper’s reported data, not invented numbers. Tolerance of 0.2 accounts for reading uncertainty and implementation differences.

outputs.description: CSV file with one row per independent simulation seed, containing the interaction parameters and the measured fractions of monomers in partially crystalline and crystalline states, along with the computed scaled crystal yield. The checker will compute the per-condition mean scaled yield and compare it to the paper’s reference value using a relative tolerance.

output_contract.notes: The agent is expected to run dynamic simulations for the specified list of (epsilon_n, epsilon_d) pairs and per-seed counts. The equilibrium phase diagram is not required for scoring; only the dynamic yield data is scored.

steps.description: Group by (epsilon_d, epsilon_n), compute mean f_c_scaled, compare to hidden gold within relative tolerance 0.2 (absolute floor 0.05). Return fraction of conditions matching.
